definition: A time or set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something.
example: Education gives you more opportunities in life.

definition: Continued effort to do or achieve something despite difficulties or failure.
example: Through hard work and perseverance, he succeeded in his career.
example_uz: Mashaqqatli mehnat va qat'iyat evaziga u o'z karyerasida muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

definition: The ability to speak or write a language easily, well, and quickly.
example: Daily practice is the key to speaking with great fluency.
example_uz: Har kungi mashq erkin va ravon gapirishning kalitidir.

definition: Able to quickly return to a good condition after difficulty or change.
example: Children are remarkably resilient and adapt fast to new surroundings.
example_uz: Bolalar ajoyib darajada moslashuvchan va yangi muhitga tez ko'nikadilar.

definition: Able to express thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively in words.
translation_uz: fikrini aniq va ifodali bayon qila oladigan
example: She is an articulate speaker who can persuade any audience.
example_uz: U har qanday tinglovchini ishontira oladigan notiq va ifodali so'zlovchidir.

definition: To understand something fully and completely.
example: I could not fully comprehend the complexity of the problem.
example_uz: Muammoning naqadar murakkabligini to'liq anglay olmadim.

definition: Very careful and showing great attention to every detail.
example: He conducted a meticulous review of the English grammar rules.
example_uz: U ingliz tili grammatika qoidalarini sinchkovlik bilan ko'rib chiqdi.

definition: Always behaving or happening in a similar, especially positive, way.
example: Consistent daily study of 15 minutes is better than 4 hours once a week.
example_uz: Kuniga 15 daqiqa muntazam o'rganish haftada bir marta 4 soat o'rgangandan yaxshiroqdir.

definition: Giving a clear, strong message, expressing feelings powerfully in speech.
example: His eloquent presentation captured everyone's admiration.
example_uz: Uning ta'sirchan taqdimoti barchaning olqishiga sazovor bo'ldi.

definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere at the same time.
translation_uz: hamma joyda hozir bo'lgan, keng tarqalgan
example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern everyday life.
example_uz: Smartfonlar zamonaviy kundalik hayotda hamma joyda uchraydigan buyumga aylandi.

definition: Having a strong desire for success or achievement.
example: She has ambitious plans to study for her Master's in the UK.
example_uz: Uning Buyuk Britaniyada magistraturada o'qish bo'yicha katta rejalari bor.

definition: A feeling of trust in one's abilities, qualities, and judgment.
example: Practicing speaking every day will boost your confidence.
example_uz: Har kuni gapirishni mashq qilish o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchni oshiradi.
